decision.reason: The only evidence is one changelog line [ev-cc5436d99c53]: it says tsdb_shipper storage_config is now generated even when using_boltdb_shipper is false. It does not say where using_boltdb_shipper comes from. It could be a Helm values key, a Loki config setting or an internal template variable, and nothing gives the path "storage.using_boltdb_shipper" that the proposal uses. The surrounding Bug Fixes section adds nothing about which configuration triggers the generation or what affected environments see, so the proposed values-key condition cannot be confirmed or corrected. Deciding this needs the PR 11195 diff or upgrade-guide text that names the key, its location and the setups that previously lacked tsdb_shipper config.
